next_gate: The initial graph transition is now verified in the requested direction: ordered layout to progressively free motion on both the search map and configurator; repeated canvas samples found no blank sample at 100 ms resolution. Criterion (0) remains partial until a readable saved configurator graph snapshot is verified. Complete criterion (1) by verifying and, if needed, adding preservation/restoration of search filters alongside the saved shortlist; the filtered group, focused-person snapshot, and local restore path were exercised on 2026-11-07, but filter restoration remains open. Then close role-specific entry materials and tutorial paths, source-provenance/consent/intake requirements, candidate KPI passports, organization isolation, target-user readability review, survey approval, and partner/architect handoff with financial source passports. No budget values or production claims without sourced and approved assumptions. Continue only in the existing code worktree; do not commit, push, deploy, delete branches, or alter published history without explicit approval.
